title: RESYNC_REQUEST message (both directions, v1, draft)
description: Asks the other party to re-publish its current state: MBin asks MTap for recommendations and exits still valid; MTap asks MBin for parameters, positions and outcomes. Re-publishes keep their original _key. Streams mtap:evt:RESYNC_REQUEST and mbin:evt:RESYNC_REQUEST, tail-only. See mtap-mbin-protocol.md section 8.7.

_key.description: rs:<party>:<instance_id>:<seq>; request_id is the part after rs:.

request_id.description: Echoed as correlation_id on every re-published message.

since_ts_utc.description: RECOMMENDATION_OUTCOME only: re-drive outcomes newer than this. Ignored for the other types, which are re-sent as current state.
